name: Washington House Bill 2225 — Concerning Artificial Intelligence Companion Chatbots
description: Washington State statute regulating AI companion chatbots: requires clear and periodic disclosure that the user is interacting with an AI system, prohibits deceptive human or licensed-clinician impersonation, mandates crisis intervention protocols for suicidal ideation, self-harm, and eating-disorder triggers, and establishes minor protections enforced under the Washington Consumer Protection Act (RCW 19.86).
relationToCloudSecurity: Establishes statutory or regulatory compliance obligations issued by State of Washington (wa.gov) applicable to cloud service providers, data controllers, and digital operators.
relationToAISecurity: Governs data protection, automated decision-making, cybersecurity, or AI system compliance within State of Washington (wa.gov).
